Fixes bug B-main-red-brief-wording: Heading is now ## RESUME: recoverable work found; tests search the old text or an order the brief no longer has. 7 of the 288 failing ids on main 057a4a6b0 (gate event ee9be0cdf3faaebca2413c9b5), grouped by error text: test_brief_budget_sections.py::test_a_tiny_budget_is_still_a_budget, test_brief_recovery_all.py::test_a_running_item_with_no_lease_is_in_the_brief, test_brief_recovery_all.py::test_an_unmeasurable_worktree_is_in_the_brief, test_brief_recovery_all.py::test_salvageable_work_still_comes_first_and_clean_leftovers_are_counted, test_decisions_recall.py::test_status_surfaces_loops_and_recoverable_work, test_session_start_resume.py::test_the_brief_itself_puts_recoverable_work_before_new_work, test_session_start_resume.py::test_the_session_start_output_opens_with_the_resume_block

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-main-red-brief-wording --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-main-red-brief-wording --regression-test <test>` first).

Scope measured by red-d at 164ff741b: 8 failures, not 7 (test_recovery_plan.py::test_plain_recover_is_unchanged_on_a_clean_project joins, from Be3461fc98e). tests/test_recovery_plan.py and ddflow/views/markdown/briefing.py added to the globs. The two test_session_start_resume.py failures need ddflow/api/lifecycle/brief.py, held by B-hy-stop-protocol and PS-git-batch: see the follow-up task.

data.body:
Fixes bug Be8ca1270a5: `ddflow_bug found` with item=fix-B-main-red-brief-wording (phase P-green-main) put fix-B-brief-choices-above-resume under bugs-2; it had to be moved by hand.
